blurb: A wonderfully smooth decaf with full flavour — the perfect, comforting brew.
story: Decaf is usually an afterthought. Here it gets the same care as everything else on the menu: properly brewed, full-bodied and served in very nice china. A scone on the side is strongly advised.

blurb: Crispy-edged, juicy and full of flavour — a smash burger done properly.
story: Lacy, caramelised edges, properly melted cheese, sharp pickles and a glossy bun that's up to the job. Get the fries.

blurb: Creamy mushrooms on toasted sourdough with pickle and crispy bacon. Delicious!
story: Creamy mushrooms on toasted sourdough with pickle and crispy bacon. Delicious food and warm welcoming service.

blurb: Lovely retro, slightly cheeky, door panel that greets you on the way to the Gents loo.

blurb: The Roastie Toastie - an entire hot roast chicken dinner inside a toasted sandwich!
